recent_articles.title: CUET-UG delayed at some centres due to technical glitch; TCS says 'regret inconvenience'
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Testing Agency (NTA)** announced a technical glitch delayed the commencement of the CUET-UG 2026 exam at some centres on Saturday. **TCS**, which is responsible for the exam's technical infrastructure, identified and resolved the issue promptly, allowing the exam to resume with compensatory time.  Students and parents reported significant delays and lack of communication at several examination centers. The CUET-UG is a national-level entrance exam for undergraduate admissions across central, state, and select private universities in India.

recent_articles.title: Weekend Reads | Old soldiers never die: The diary of an unsung INA trooper - Telegraph India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lieutenant Colonel Dr Benoy Kumar Nandy**, a former medical officer in the Indian Medical Service, joined the **Indian National Army (INA)** during World War II.  After the Japanese invasion of Singapore, he and other INA members were transferred to Burma. The INA faced setbacks due to British air raids and logistical issues. Nandy was captured by the Allied forces and held as a prisoner of war. He later became involved in the **Azad Hind Fauj**, reorganized under **Subhas Chandra Bose**.  Nandy's journal details his experiences, including his time at makeshift hospitals and encounters with prominent figures like **Netaji** (Bose). After the INA was disbanded, Nandy returned to India but faced challenges as a result of his involvement.

recent_articles.title: 'Hang my son': Plea of accused's parents shocks Kashmir after 12-year-old’s rape and murder
recent_articles.rephrased_article: In the small village of Galwanpora, **Kashmir**, a 12-year-old girl was murdered and her family is mourning.  **Mudasir Ahmad Mir**, a 30-year-old auto driver from the same village, has been arrested for allegedly raping and murdering the girl. The accused's parents have demanded the harshest punishment for their son, shocking the community. This incident has deeply shaken the village, as it is rare for families of accused to demand such harsh punishments in cases of extreme brutality.

recent_articles.title: Government schools | 51,000 government schools closed with a year, says report - Telegraph India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The number of government schools in India decreased by 4.78% between September 2018 and September 2019, while private school enrollment increased by 3.6%. Education activists argue this trend reflects a push towards privatization due to the government's policy of closing low-enrolment schools through mergers.  The decline is attributed to factors like teacher shortages, inadequate teaching quality, and the lack of focus on learning outcomes in many government schools. This has led parents to opt for private schools, further exacerbating the issue.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chirag Tyagi**, a Paralympic athlete, was found dead in **Ghaziabad** on Saturday.  Police arrested **Yash Khatik**, another paralympic athlete who allegedly shot Tyagi with a pistol after Tyagi filed a complaint about Khatik's document verification. The case is under investigation and police are trying to find other individuals involved.
